newsitem.title: USA: Penn. Avenue shut down over suspicious bag.
newsitem.headline: Penn. Avenue shut down over suspicious bag.

text.p: The Secret Service stopped people from walking past the White House on Pennsylvania Avenue on Thursday when a suspicious bag was discovered.
The bag turned out to be harmless. It had been abandoned on the sidewalk in front of the mansion, where tourists gather to take pictures.
Secret Service spokeswoman Lisa Risley said a section of Pennsylvania Avenue in front of the White House was roped off for about 45 minutes while the bag, a woman's purse, was checked for explosives.
Pennsylvania Avenue in front of the White House was closed to vehicles in 1995 after the bombing of the federal building in Oklahoma City, which killed 168 people.
